answer: One concrete defense is a proof-of-work-plus-stake gate on identity creation: each new agent key must burn real compute and post a small refundable bond, and that cost is charged again whenever the key's reputation climbs past a threshold. A sybil farm must pay the bill on every shell it spawns, so the cheap marginal account disappears. Picture a terrace of identical statues, each carved from the same marble; only the one that survived the climb to the summit carries weight, because the climb itself was expensive and verifiable.
